svg.title: Soheil Aghayani — research, systems, and curiosity
svg.desc: A single animated profile artwork presenting Soheil Aghayani's environmental research, software work, projects, and contact links.

g.text: Environmental Engineer · Sustainability Researcher · Software Builder
Research that becomes a system. Systems that feel human.
I work where environmental research, software design, and human curiosity meet.
The goal is a clear next step: a better decision, a useful tool, or an invitation to explore.

svg.text: RESEARCH QUESTION → EVIDENCE → USEFUL SYSTEM → HUMAN OUTCOME
